dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast perimeters of low-intensity (dark) pixels transitioning via steep gradients to high-intensity (light) centers. Edges are predominantly irregular and scalloped, particularly in the central dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized, solid high-intensity clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated on the lower lateral flanks and anterior neck region, interspersed between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent mid-dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle. A secondary quadrilateral relationship is formed by four high-intensity blobs located on the posterior-lateral flank.
